bibliographic.title: House of Loki
bibliographic.author: Alex Kubodera
bibliographic.description:
When fate comes knocking with a hammer and sword, will you be able to break the chains of destiny?

This is a tale of family and prophecy inspired by the Eddas of Norse Mythology. This is not a retelling, but an exploration of what is unsaid, guided by your actions. Immerse yourself in the cold winters of Jotunheimr and see the world from the perspective of those who would destroy it.
